rows.en: That's the voice of that young man from before!?
You monsters! Get out!! You're the ones ravaging this mountain, aren't you?

This has nothing to do with you, boy… We are in the middle of an important experiment. The animals and plants make perfect targets!

But… soon we won't need them anymore. The new weapon, the Danger Light, is nearly complete! Now then… boy, you are going to die.
Uoooh!?
This is bad! We have to save him!!
Nngh, they've interfered… Retreat for now.

Hey, hang in there, hey!

…!? He's still alive.
Ugh… ngh.
[HERO4], can you heal him?

No, my power can't…

Some special bacterium has been injected into him! At this rate…
[HERO4], do your usual thing, please.

Hmm, some special "bacterium" has been injected into him. At this rate he'll die…

I'm pretty sure… Grandpa said my healing power… the power of the Vol cells, gets blocked by certain kinds of bacteria…

That's it… Planet Bird's advanced medicine might be able to save him!

That's the only way to save him!!
But are you sure about this… Gavan? You need to find your father as soon as possible…
But, Gavan… what about your father?
Of course I want to see my father soon! But I can't abandon this young man either… My father would understand.
To save the life of the young man Den Iga, Space Sheriff Gavan headed for Planet Bird. And two weeks passed…
So, does it look like that young man will make it?
He was in a pretty critical condition… but it seems he's past the worst. He's got an incredible will to live.
Gavan, about your father…
Yes… Since Makuu was there, most likely my father is…
No, that's not all! While you were back on Planet Bird… we did some digging of our own.
And what we found out… is that the research facility in Kirifukidani had already fallen into the hands of Makuu and Shocker.
What!? Makuu and Shocker? Damn it, what are they plotting?
Hmm… It probably has something to do with that plasma energy.
In any case… let's go there once more.
Yeah…

…!?

Makuu and Shocker have come out to greet us!

…!?

Damn… Is this a Makuu and Shocker ambush!?
Father, please wait for me… All right, everyone, let's go!!
Welcome. Please, take any free seat…
Ah, no… Is there someone here by the name of Taki?
Taki… is out at the moment. What business do you have with him?
The truth is… I've created something terrible.
Something terrible?

This is bad!!

Shocker is using the Danger Light on people one after another… Where's Hongo? Where is he?
Taki… Calm down a little, would you! You've got a visitor.
Dr. Shirakawa… What are you doing here?
Mr. Taki… There's something about my sister's kidnapping that I kept from you.
Could it be… it has something to do with this Danger Light?
I'm the one who made it… And I gave a locket with its blueprints inside to my sister for her birthday.
So then… your sister was kidnapped by Shocker because of that locket?

Most likely…

And Shocker has turned the doctor's invention, the Danger Light, into a weapon.

It's my fault! If only I hadn't put the microfilm in a locket…

Mr. Taki… Machiko may… no longer be alive.
That's not…

It'll be all right… They're not the type to be satisfied with killing two or three people, you know?

To Shocker, your sister still has value to exploit! Which means she's definitely alive.

Hey, Taki! Get in touch with Takeshi and the others right away! Let's rescue your sister as soon as we can.

Takeshi Hongo, Hayato Ichimonji…

We of Shocker and Makuu have completed the killing ray, the Danger Light! This Makuu base will soon be abandoned…

And… this woman has already served her purpose!
Eeek, help meee!!
Doctor Death, what are you going to do with that girl?
Doctor Death, what are you going to do with that girl?

…!?

Mr. Hongo, an emergency message from Mr. Taki!

He says Dr. Shirakawa's sister has been kidnapped by Shocker.
Ah…
Mr. Hongo, an emergency call from Mr. Taki!
He says Dr. Shirakawa's sister's been kidnapped by Shocker…
What!? Then she's…?
What!? Then she's…?

That's it, now I get it!

Makuu plans to convert the Danger Light into plasma energy and build a planet-destroying missile!

That's it, now I get it!

Makuu plans to convert the Danger Light into plasma energy and build a planet-destroying missile!
A planet-destroying missile!?
A planet-destroying missile!?
A planet-destroying missile!?

That's right…

Plasma energy… which means… my father must be there after all!?

That's right…

Plasma energy… which means… my father must be there after all!?

Exactly right, Gavan! But we're keeping Voicer.

As the only person who knows the device's secrets, he'll cooperate in developing the planet-destroying missile! Looks like you were a bit too late, eh? Farewell, ha ha ha ha…
Damn it… Hunter Killer! I won't forgive you!
Damn it… Hunter Killer! I won't forgive you!

…!?

That's strange… Why is only Shocker pulling out?

…!?

That's strange… Why is only Shocker pulling out?

Damn… They've planted bombs in the base, haven't they?

Their plan is to blow up Dr. Shirakawa's sister, Makuu and all of us together! Like hell I'll let them!

Damn… They've planted bombs in the base, haven't they?

Their plan is to blow up Dr. Shirakawa's sister, Makuu and all of us together! Like hell I'll let them!
Leader… I have set the Makuu base to blow up along with Shirakawa's sister.

No!! You must not kill Shirakawa's sister! Use her as bait to lure out Dr. Shirakawa!

Listen well! The next stage will be an even greater operation!

We will destroy airliners, passenger ships, passenger trains and more with the Danger Light! We will make the skies, seas and lands of the whole world belong to our Shocker!

To complete the powerful device for that, we need Shirakawa's cooperation! Bring me Shirakawa!

Hmm… But, Leader! If I may…

We have a collaborator named Voicer in our hands. Even without Dr. Shirakawa's help, completing the device should…

Fool!! Voicer is in Makuu's hands now.

Before they complete the planet-destroying missile, we must complete an even more powerful Danger Light!
Meaning?

The one who will rule the world… no, the entire universe, is neither DARK nor Makuu… It is our Shocker!

Once the Hyper Danger Light is complete, we can simply steal the planet-destroying missile from Makuu.
Truly, you are our Shocker's Leader. As you command…
Why? Shocker's coming back!
Why? Shocker's coming back!

uncertain: U02411: Den Iga's 化け物 rendered 'monsters' (plural, as he addresses 'お前たち')
U02421: 細菌 in brackets rendered as quoted "bacterium"
U02451/U02454: ロケット read as 'locket' (pendant), not rocket
U02462-U02464: one [HERO4] line split across a dialogue row and two narration-kind rows
U02483: Ambassador Hell says ボイサー is 'in our hands' though Hunter Killer (Makuu) holds him; translated as written (the Leader corrects him in U02484)

new_names.why: Dr. Shirakawa's sister, not in glossary
